subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Does an authorized OpenClaw workflow-security owner approve these exact third-party action revisions to execute in workflows that receive OpenAI API keys, GitHub App private keys, registry credentials, or repository tokens?
rationale: This is a supply-chain trust decision over code outside the PR author’s control; automated review cannot grant approval for new executable revisions in secret-bearing workflows.

options.title: Audit and approve the exact revisions
options.body: Review the upstream release/source for every secret-bearing action revision, then allow merge after a rebase and exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split or hold sensitive updates
options.body: Keep low-risk action updates separate and defer the secret-bearing revisions until their source audit is completed.

options.title: Reject the batch update
options.body: Close this Dependabot PR if the repository does not want to accept these action revisions after audit.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the exact revisions
recommendation.body: Review the upstream release/source for every secret-bearing action revision, then allow merge after a rebase and exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-wide CI credential boundaries require a repository-level owner decision; available evidence does not identify a more specific current workflow owner.
